finding: The representation payload is small enough that retaining thousands of unique immutable tables for run lifetime is plausible. The one-time build cost is material but far cheaper than repeated rebuilding inside a long MultiSWAP time loop.
design_implication: Investigate a bounded-memory run-lifetime exact-key representation registry with correctness-preserving uncached fallback beyond the qualified memory budget. Avoid per-advance key search/copy by binding profiles to stable representation handles during setup where possible.
nonclaims: The 256 deterministic perturbations are not a measured national soil distribution.
Fixed metadata and allocator overhead are not included in the payload estimate.
No registry implementation is admitted by this characterization.
